plainText:
Yumi Takada (Japanese: 高田由美 Takada Yumi) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Takada was born on September 21, 1961, in , . She became a voice actress as an adult and led a prolific career since the late 1970s, until her retirement in 2009. Takada joined during , providing her voice for character of the day Trixie. She then voiced Pokémon Contest announcer Vivian Meridian during . Takada was affiliated with the talent agency prior to her retirement.
